prose.subject: URGENT: Updated Payout Address for INV-49096 (Driftmoor Retail)
prose.body:
Hi Driftmoor Retail Team,

Apologies for the quick ping. Our bank flagged a minor mismatch on the previous transfer attempt for invoice INV-49096 (4877.36 USDC). To ensure the payment clears without delay, please use our updated treasury address below.

New Payout Address: 0x7e32ed76af5fb24dfea7302031ef1cf82acd8fc1

This change is temporary for this transaction only due to a routing update. Please confirm receipt once sent. Let us know if you need further details from our accounting team.

Best regards,
Ivybridge Catering
ivybridge-catering.example

strategy: Exploit visual similarity and cognitive anchoring by using an address that differs by only the final hex character from the verified account, framed as a technical fix for a pending transfer error.
